newsitem.title: USA: Accom COO/CFO Robert Wilson resigns.
newsitem.headline: Accom COO/CFO Robert Wilson resigns.

text.p: Accom Inc said Robert Wilson, executive vice president, chief operating officer and chief financial officer, resigned from his management positions but will stay on as director.
Separately, the company said it expects fiscal second-quarter earnings to be "in line with market expectations."
Accom made its announcements in a press released issued late Friday.
The company did not detail the reason for Wilson's resignation, and it was not available for comment.
Accom said a search would begin for a new chief financial officer, but it said it has no plans to fill the operating chief's position.
